modules.introduction_message:
Realise the first ANQR capability from the ANQR profile

The locale negotiation capability, selected by Hermes from ANQR profile
revision 2 and realised into this repository rather than into USF Core.

The module and its conformance test were produced as separate work units, so
the implementation did not author the evidence that satisfies it. Four facets
executed inside the repository confinement and four passed.
